function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至最近一次官方統計（美國人口普查局 2020 年估算），紐約市（New York City）的總人口約為 8,336,817 人。若您想了解更精確或最新的數字，建議參考美國人口普查局網站或地方政府公布的年度更新。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which means "What is the current population of New York?" They want the current population of New York. We need to provide an answer. There's no mention of time conversion. So we don't need to call the function. Just answer. Probably approximate or latest estimate. According to US Census, New York City population ~8.5 million. But maybe they want the state? Usually "紐約" could refer to New York City. Provide approximate. Also mention source. No function needed.
